fieldValues.title: A decision is shown with its compass
fieldValues.decision_question: How does a decision record show the compass it was weighed on?
fieldValues.context:
Owner, 2026-10-22: decisions should always be set against the principles and the compass; avoid seeing decisions without their context and compass. Where the principles give the answer and nothing argues against it, record the choice inline and proceed.
Compass: the Reviewable and fast tension held at SemanticOps. Mode: clear; it extends ratified 70a84bb7 and e56d6893.
fieldValues.friction: Decisions reach the owner as bundles without the principles they rest on, so a ratification cannot be judged against the compass (SP-92, SP-93), and choices the principles already answer are filed as decisions.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
(a) Do nothing: a decision record need not show what it was weighed against; a reader judges it without its compass.
(b) The compass in prose only: readable, but nothing can check it or bring a decision back with its principles.
(c) A set-against link from the decision to each principle or standing decision it rests on, with the rationale saying applies or departs (chosen).
fieldValues.key_requirements: A reader sees each decision with the principles it applies or departs from, and a tool can list them.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Every decision record is set against the principles and standing decisions it rests on, and its rationale says whether it applies or departs from each.
fieldValues.rationale: Extends e56d6893 (a design decision cites its principle) to every decision kind and makes the citation a checkable link, so the compass travels with the decision (SP-93). Choices an affirmed principle or the group lean already answers stay out of the record and cite the principle inline, as 70a84bb7 already rules.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Records are set against principles by rote, or inline choices hide a departure from a lean.
fieldValues.next_steps: pr-check and the session recorder warn when a proposed decision has no set-against link (convention first, e337703b).
